Billboard.AnchorHint.zh: X / Y 表示画布平面上的地面锚点；离地高度使用逻辑长度。
Billboard.AnchorHint.en: X / Y locate the ground anchor on the canvas plane; elevation uses logical units.

Billboard.ConversionFailed.zh: 当前位置无法转换放置方式，请调整图层位置或画布透视。
Billboard.ConversionFailed.en: Placement cannot be converted here. Adjust the layer position or canvas perspective.

Billboard.InvalidDepth.zh: 当前角度无法确定立牌落点。
Billboard.InvalidDepth.en: Cannot determine a billboard anchor at this angle.

Billboard.ChooseDepth.zh: 点击选择深度，然后绘制
Billboard.ChooseDepth.en: Click to choose a depth, then draw
